selectedResponsibility.description: Construct per-endpoint valid, invalid-field, auth, not-found and idempotency cases.

residualResponsibilities.description: Catalog all REST endpoints, schema and auth; introspect GraphQL when applicable.
Check media type, body schema, headers and pagination metadata.
Create/read/update/delete resources and verify persistence and deletion.
Exercise oversized/media/rate errors and GraphQL shapes, errors, depth and mutation validation.
Deliver resource-organized tests, request/response examples, compliance report, endpoint matrix and CI step.
Diagnose environment, token, schema, fixture and rate-limit failures.
